question: Anil took some loan on simple interest at a certain rate and paid ₹12,800 as interest after 2 years. His friend Sumit also borrowed the same sum on compound interest for the same period and same rate of interest compounded annually and paid ₹704 more interest than that paid by Anil. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

S.I = Rs. 12800

Time = 2 years

Difference of C.I and S.I = Rs. 704

**Concept used:**

Difference between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years:

Difference = P × (R/100)2

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Here, P = principal or sum, T = time, R = rate of interest
